problem.ci.githubIntegrationNeeded: Say which GitHub integration’s workflow runs are builds. Add a GitHub integration first, then give its id.
problem.ci.manyBuildFields: {project} has {count} build fields. Say which one its builds go in: {fields}.

problem.ci.notGithub: {integration} isn''t a GitHub integration. Workflow runs come from GitHub Actions; any other CI posts its builds with a token: choose "Any CI".
problem.ci.postingTakesNoBranch: A CI that posts its builds takes no branch or workflow. It says its branch as it posts each build.
problem.ci.postingTakesNoSource: A CI that posts its builds takes no integration, branch or workflow. It says which build it is, and its branch, as it posts each one.
problem.ci.rangeNeedsRepository: A range needs its repository. Give "repository": "owner/name", or send the commits themselves.

problem.ci.signedByGiteaIntegration: Its builds come signed by its Gitea or Forgejo integration. Give the integration a new secret instead.
problem.ci.signedByIntegration: Its builds come signed by its GitHub integration. Give the integration a new secret instead.

problem.command.actionNotOffered: “{action}” isn''t offered for {issue} now. It''s for issues that match “{condition}”.
problem.command.actionOtherIssue: Run as a command, “{action}” changes only {issue}, not {other}. Use its button on the issue.
problem.command.actionRunsAction: The action “{action}” runs another action, “{other}”, and an action can''t.
problem.command.empty: The command is empty. e.g. "State Fixed" or "for me".
problem.command.issueIdNotCommand: "{id}" is an issue id, not a command. A command applies to the chosen issues, so leave it out. To link to {id}, say how, e.g. "relates to {id}".
problem.command.noAssigneeField: These issues have no Assignee field.
problem.command.noSuchSprint: No board of this issue''s project has a sprint called {name}. Name a sprint of one of its boards.
problem.command.notADuration: "{value}" is not a duration for {field}. Use e.g. 2d, 4h or 1w 2d.
problem.command.scriptRunsScript: “{action}” is a scripted action, and a script can''t run another script.

problem.command.sprintArchived: {sprint} is archived. Choose a sprint that is still open.
problem.command.sprintName: Expected the name of a sprint. e.g. "sprint Sprint 4", or "remove sprint Sprint 4".
problem.command.sprintNotHere: Sprints are changed by a command run on issues. Leave the sprint clause out here.
problem.command.tagNameAfterUntag: Expected a tag name after untag.
problem.command.tooManyIssues: A command can change at most {max} issues at once. Split the list into smaller batches.

problem.command.valueOfFields: "{value}" is a value of {n, plural, =2 {{first} and {last}} other {{fields}}}. Say which one, e.g. "{first} {value}".
problem.comments.changedBySomeoneElse: The comment was changed by someone else (version {version}, you sent {expectedVersion}). Reload the comment, then make your change again.
problem.comments.notFromHelpdesk: {id} didn't come in through a help desk, so a comment on it can't be public. Leave out "visibility", or send "internal".
problem.comments.onlyOwn: You can only change your own comments. Managers of the project can change anyone’s.
problem.comments.publicCantBeLimited: A public comment goes to the requester, so it can’t be limited to some people too. Send it as internal to limit it, or leave out "visibleTo".
problem.comments.wentToRequester: This comment went to the requester, so it can’t be limited to some people. Leave it as it is, or delete it.
problem.conditions.doesNotReadSaying: The condition doesn't read: {problem}{hasHint, select, yes {} other { Write it as a search, e.g. State: Fixed.}}
problem.conditions.required: {name} is required when {condition}. Set {name} in the same change.
problem.conditions.saysNothing: The condition doesn't say anything. Write it as a search, e.g. State: Fixed.
problem.customerGroups.agentCantTakeRequ: {login} can't be given {project}'s requests. Choose someone of {project} who may change its issues.
problem.customerGroups.changedMeanwhile: Another change to the desk’s customer groups came first. Reload the desk’s settings and try again.
problem.customerGroups.domainTaken: {domain} puts requesters in {group} already. A domain names one group at a desk: take it from {group} first.
problem.customerGroups.groupNotFound: Customer group not found. It may have been deleted: reload the desk’s settings.
problem.customerGroups.inAnotherGroup: {email} is in {group} at this desk. A requester is in one group at a desk: take them out of {group} first.
problem.customerGroups.memberNotFound: Member not found. They may have been taken out already: reload the group.
problem.customerGroups.nameTaken: {project} has a customer group called {name}. Give this one another name.
problem.customerGroups.notARequest: {id} is no help desk request. Only requests filed through a help desk have a customer group.
problem.customerGroups.tooMany: A desk has {n, plural, one {# customer group} other {# customer groups}} at most. Delete one that is no longer used.
problem.customerGroups.unknownAgent: Unknown user "{login}". Use the login of someone of the project.
problem.dashboards.boardNotFound: Board {board} not found. GET /boards lists the boards you can see.
problem.dashboards.changedBySomeoneElse: "{name}" was changed by someone else (version {version}, you sent {expectedVersion}). Reload it and make your change again.
problem.dashboards.duplicateWidgetId: Two widgets have the id "{id}". Give each widget an id of its own.
problem.dashboards.needsBoardOrSprint: {titled, select, yes {"{title}"} other {widget {wid}}} needs a board (for its current sprint) or a sprint.

problem.dashboards.notFoundListThem: Dashboard not found. GET /dashboards lists yours and the shared ones.
problem.dashboards.onlyOwnerChanges: Only its owner can change a dashboard. Make a copy of it to change it: create a dashboard with its widgets.
problem.dashboards.onlyOwnerDeletes: Only its owner can delete a dashboard.
problem.dashboards.queryHasProblems: The query of {titled, select, yes {"{title}"} other {widget {wid}}} has problems: {problems} Fix the query, or try it on the Issues page first.
problem.dashboards.savedSearchNotFound: Saved search {savedSearch} not found. Use one of yours, or a shared one: GET /saved-searches lists them.
problem.dashboards.tooManyWidgets: A dashboard holds {MAX_WIDGETS} widgets at most.
problem.deskMailbox.addressFirst: Give the desk an address first. Its mailbox is the one mail to that address reaches.
problem.deskMailbox.needsUserAndPassword: The mailbox needs a user and a password. Write them in the address: imaps://user:password@host/INBOX.
problem.deskMailbox.notImap: That is no IMAP address. Write it as imaps://user:password@host/INBOX; imap:// must upgrade with STARTTLS.
problem.emails.addedAlready: You’ve added that email already. Send its link again from your list of emails.
problem.emails.cantSendHere: a4a can’t send email here. Ask an administrator to confirm the email.
problem.emails.confirmFirst: Confirm it first. Only a confirmed email can be your primary one.
problem.emails.confirmedForSomeoneElse: This email is confirmed for someone else in a4a. An administrator can move it to you.
problem.emails.enoughLinks: a4a has sent you enough links for now. Try again in an hour, or ask an administrator to confirm the email.
problem.emails.linkForOtherAccount: This link is for another account in a4a. Sign in as the person who added the email, then open it again.
problem.emails.linkJustSent: A link went to it a moment ago. Look for it, in spam too; a new one can go in a minute.
problem.emails.linkNotValid: This link isn’t valid. It works once, for 24 hours: send a new one from your profile.
problem.emails.notYours: That email among yours not found.
problem.emails.notYoursAddFirst: That email among yours not found. Add it first.
problem.emails.primaryConfirmed: That’s your primary email, and it’s confirmed.
problem.emails.signedInNotToken: Your emails are changed signed in, not with a token. Open your profile in a4a.
problem.emails.takenBy: {name} has this email confirmed already. Remove it from {name} first: a confirmed email is one person's.
problem.emails.tooManyOthers: You have {MAX_OTHER_EMAILS} other emails already. Remove one you no longer use first.
problem.emails.tooManyOthersFor: {name} has {MAX_OTHER_EMAILS} other emails already. Remove one first.
problem.events.shuttingDown: This server is shutting down. Reconnect: another instance serves the stream and resumes it.
problem.fields.cantBePrivate: {name} can't be private. a4a reads it for everyone: whether an issue is resolved, and who has it. Make another field private instead.
problem.fields.conditionReadsPrivate: {name}'s condition reads {other}, a private field, and everyone sees {name}. Make {name} private too, or write its condition with fields everyone sees.
problem.fields.noListOfValues: {name} does not have a list of values.
problem.fields.notOwned: {name} is not an owned field, so its values have no owners. Make it owned first (PATCH the field with '{'"type": "owned"'}').
problem.fields.onlyEnumBecomesOwned: {name} is a {type} field. Only an enum field becomes owned, and back.
problem.fields.onlyStateResolves: Only state fields have resolved values.
problem.fields.readByCondition: {name} can't be private while {other}'s condition reads it. Everyone sees {other}, so it would show and hide by a value they can't see. Change that condition first, or make {other} private too.
problem.fields.typeTakesNoValues: {type} fields do not take a list of values.
problem.fields.unknownOwner: Unknown user "{owner}". Give a login or a name.
problem.fields.valueInUseBy: This value is used by {n, plural, one {# issue} other {# issues}}. Archive it instead (PATCH with '{'"archived": true'}'), or change those issues first.
problem.forbidden: You do not have permission to do this.
problem.groups.fromProvider: Who is in {name} comes from the identity provider. It's set at each sign-in, from the groups the provider says someone is in (as "{providerName}"). Change it there, or make the group one kept by hand: PATCH /groups/{id} with providerName null.
problem.groups.hasRoleAlready: {name} already has a role in {key}. Change its role instead: PATCH /projects/{key}/groups/{id}.
problem.groups.nameTaken: There's already a group called "{name}". Choose another name, or add people to that one.
problem.groups.notFoundUseIdOrName: Group {ref} not found. Use its id or its name, as in GET /groups.
problem.groups.notInProjectGiveRole: {name} among {key}'s groups not found. Give it a role first: POST /projects/{key}/groups.
problem.groups.providerNameTaken: Another group already comes from "{providerName}" at the identity provider. One group per name there: change that one, or use another name.
problem.groups.userNotFound: User {login} not found. Use their login, as in GET /users.
problem.helpdesk.captchaExpired: The check that you’re not a bot has expired. It runs again by itself: send the request once more.
problem.helpdesk.captchaFailed: The check that you’re not a bot didn’t pass. Reload the page and send it again: what you wrote is still there.
problem.helpdesk.crossSite: Cross-site request refused. Send it from the help desk page itself.

problem.helpdesk.deskClosed: The help desk can't take requests right now. An administrator should give the person with the login "helpdesk" another login.
problem.helpdesk.formExpired: This form has expired. Reload the page and send it again: what you wrote is still there.
problem.helpdesk.hoursBackwards: Working hours end after they start: {from}–{to} doesn''t. For hours past midnight, give two spans: one to 24:00 and one from 00:00 the next day.
problem.helpdesk.hoursNeedDay: Working hours need at least one day. Add the hours the team works, such as Monday 09:00–17:00.
problem.helpdesk.hoursOverlap: {day, select, sun {Sunday} mon {Monday} tue {Tuesday} wed {Wednesday} thu {Thursday} fri {Friday} other {Saturday}}''s working hours overlap. Give each part of the day once.
problem.helpdesk.linkOpensNoRequest: This link doesn't open a request. Use the link in your latest email about it, whole.
problem.helpdesk.noDesk: There's no help desk here. Check the address you were given.
problem.helpdesk.requestNotFound: A help desk request for {id} not found. Only issues filed through a help desk have one.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyChangesNow: Too many changes just now. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyForForm: Too many requests for this form. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyFromAddress: Too many requests from your address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyFromEmail: Too many requests from this email address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyLinksForEmail: Too many sign-in links for this email address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyLinksFromAddress: Too many sign-in links from your address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyRepliesFromAddre: Too many replies from your address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyRepliesNow: Too many replies just now. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyRepliesToRequest: Too many replies to this request just now. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyRequests: Too many requests. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyRequestsNow: Too many requests just now. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManySignIns: Too many sign-ins from your address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.tooManyWithoutSecret: Too many posts without the secret from your address. Try again in {unit, select, second {{n, plural, one {# second} other {# seconds}}} other {{n, plural, one {# minute} other {# minutes}}}}.
problem.helpdesk.trackingTokenMissing: Missing the tracking token. Send it in the {header} header.
problem.helpdeskMail.addressFirst: Give the desk an address first. The address is where people write; the secret lets their mail in.
problem.helpdeskMail.addressTaken: Another help desk takes mail at that address. Each desk needs an address of its own.

problem.helpdeskMail.localPartTooLong: Its part before the “@” is too long: reply addresses add {room} characters to it, and {max} is the most. Give the address people write to, such as support@acme.example.
problem.helpdeskMail.notAnAddress: That isn’t an email address. Give the address people write to, such as support@acme.example.

problem.imports.fileUnreadableSaying: The file can't be read: {message} Export it again as CSV (UTF-8, comma-separated), and upload that.

problem.imports.noColumn: There is no column {index}. Columns run from 0 to {last}.

problem.imports.source.asanaFileNowhere: Asana didn't say where the file is. Run the import again later: the files not brought yet come then.

problem.imports.source.credentialsInAddr: The address has a name and password in it. Give the address alone, and the token in its own field.
problem.imports.source.githubNotAList: GitHub's answer wasn't a list of issues. Check the address: https://api.github.com, or your GitHub Enterprise API.

problem.imports.source.hostUnknown: a4a can't find {host}. Check the address: {tracker}'s own, such as {example}.

problem.imports.source.redirectedElsewhe: {tracker} pointed a4a elsewhere ({host}). Check the address: {tracker}'s own, such as {example}.

problem.imports.unknownLink: "{phrase}" is not a link a4a knows. Links: {phrases}.
problem.imports.valuesNotMapped: Values of "{target}" aren't mapped. Map values of option fields, people (Assignee, Reporter) and sprints.
problem.imports.wrongType: The file was sent as {type}. Send the CSV itself as the body, with Content-Type: text/csv.

• BACK-12: show an issue
• BACK-12 State Fixed: apply a command to an issue (State, Assignee, for me, tag…)

• new BACK The export times out: report an issue in a project
• search #Unresolved for: me: find issues
• subscribe BACK, or subscribe "My bugs" new comments: tell this channel of a project’s or a saved search’s issues
• unsubscribe BACK: stop telling this channel of them
• link: link this chat account to your a4a account
